security_audit.summary: Most Ruby shell backtick alerts are Markdown fences or inline model IDs, not executable backtick substitution. Confirmed issues are the curl pipe-to-shell installer at SKILL.md line 17, related npx skill installation examples, and a low-risk remote README image. No prompt injection or hidden data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl pipe-to-shell quick start with pinned release downloads, checksum verification, and manual install steps.

remediation.issue: Related skill examples use npx installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Move related skill installation commands to non-executable documentation or require explicit user confirmation before any install.

remediation.issue: README embeds a remote image asset.
remediation.suggestion: Use a local marketplace asset or remove the external image to avoid automatic network requests by renderers.

content.value_statement: Creating images across many AI models can require separate tools and settings. This skill centralizes inference.sh CLI prompts for generation, editing, upscaling, and model selection.
actual_capabilities: Runs inference.sh image apps with model-specific CLI examples.
Lists available image models through the infsh app catalog.
Shows text-to-image prompts for FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, and ImagineArt.
Supports image upscaling and multi-image stitching examples.
Documents prompt fields such as aspect ratio, image URL, and text rendering requests.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and a logged-in account.
Depends on external inference.sh services and model availability.
Does not provide generated images inside the skill documentation.
The quick-start installer uses a remote shell script and needs manual review.

use_cases.title: Create Concept Art
use_cases.description: Explore several image models for characters, landscapes, posters, and product concepts from one CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Draft Marketing Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate product mockups, social graphics, and campaign images with model choices for quality and aspect ratio.

use_cases.title: Test Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Prototype image generation, upscaling, and stitching commands before adding them to internal tooling.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-image-generation skill to create a simple text-to-image prompt for [subject] with [style].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Choices
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a model for a clear goal
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend the best inference.sh image model for [goal]. Explain why it fits quality, speed, and text rendering needs.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Editing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an inference.sh CLI plan to edit [image URL] by changing [object or style]. Include required inputs and model choice.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Production Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a complete image workflow for [campaign or product]. Include generation, aspect ratio, upscaling, stitching if needed, and quality checks.

output_examples.output: Recommended model: Reve. It is documented for natural language editing and text rendering, which fits poster copy requirements.

output_examples.input: Upscale a product image for a storefront.
output: Select the Topaz upscaler app for enhancement.
Confirm the source image URL is approved for external processing.
Review the final image for artifacts before publishing.

output_examples.input: Choose a model for cinematic 4K concept art.
output_examples.output: Use Seedream 4.5 or ImagineArt 1.5 Pro based on the documented focus on high-resolution cinematic quality.

best_practices: Confirm the model and aspect ratio before running a generation.
Review prompts and images for private content before sending them to external services.
Verify CLI installation steps manually instead of piping remote scripts into a shell.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential product images without approval.
Do not rely on one model when text rendering or exact layout matters.
Do not run related skill installation commands without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the inference.sh CLI and hosted image models.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What models are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, Reve, ImagineArt, Topaz, and related image apps.

faq.question: Can it upscale existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes a Topaz image upscaler example using an image URL input.

faq.question: Can it stitch images together?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes an infsh stitching example for combining multiple image URLs.

faq.question: What security review is recommended?
faq.answer: Review the remote installer and related installation commands before publication or automated use.
